CREATE FUNCTION host_test_settled() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
    BEGIN PERFORM pg_notify('host_test_settled', NEW.operation_id); RETURN NEW; END $$

CREATE FUNCTION host_test_terminal() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
    BEGIN PERFORM pg_notify('host_test_terminal', NEW.key); RETURN NEW; END $$

CREATE TRIGGER host_test_settled AFTER UPDATE ON agent_settlements FOR EACH ROW
    WHEN (OLD.settled_at IS NULL AND NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL) EXECUTE FUNCTION host_test_settled()

CREATE TRIGGER host_test_terminal AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON pi_scalar_values FOR EACH ROW
    WHEN (NEW.namespace = 'pi.result') EXECUTE FUNCTION host_test_terminal()

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS (
    SELECT id, seq, payload FROM pi_records WHERE session_id = $1 AND kind = 'entry' AND id = $2
    UNION ALL SELECT e.id, e.seq, e.payload FROM pi_records e JOIN ancestors a ON e.id = a.payload->>'parentId'
      WHERE e.session_id = $3 AND e.kind = 'entry'
  ), stopped AS (
    SELECT *, (SELECT CASE WHEN $4 THEN min(seq) ELSE max(seq) END FROM ancestors
      WHERE id = $5 OR payload->>'type' = $6) AS stop_seq FROM ancestors
  ) SELECT CASE WHEN $7 THEN jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'parentId', payload->'parentId', 'seq', seq,
      'timestamp', payload->'timestamp', 'type', payload->'type')
      || CASE WHEN payload ? 'customType' THEN jsonb_build_object('customType', payload->'customType') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
      ELSE payload END AS entry FROM stopped
    WHERE (stop_seq IS NULL OR CASE WHEN $8 THEN seq <= stop_seq ELSE seq >= stop_seq END)
      AND ($9::text IS NULL OR payload->>'type' = $10)
      AND ($11::text IS NULL OR payload->>'customType' = $12)
      AND ($13::bigint IS NULL OR CASE WHEN $14 THEN seq > $15 ELSE seq < $16 END)
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN $17 THEN seq ELSE -seq END
